_tip_tilewidth: 400mm bed minus 12.5mm margin each side; keeps the model clear of the OrcaSlicer boundary check.
_tip_printres: Match nozzle diameter. At 0.4mm and USGS/3DEP/10m data (10m cells), optimal bbox width is ~9.5km for 1:25000 scale (one model pixel = one DEM cell). Wider bboxes coarsen the scale; split into ntilesx/ntilesy to maintain detail over larger areas.
_tip_basethick: 2mm is sturdy enough for display. Increase to 3-4mm for pieces that will be handled a lot.
_tip_ntiles: For areas wider than ~10km: set ntilesx/ntilesy to split into multiple 380mm tiles that snap together. Each tile is printed separately at the same scale.
_tip_zscale: Montana mountains: 1.0-1.5 (high relief, true scale looks good). Rolling terrain: 2.0-3.0. Low relief plains or coastal: 3.0-5.0.
